name: PhonePe
tagline: India's largest UPI app, expanding into lending, insurance and wealth
facts: 2015, Sameer Nigam, Rahul Chari, Burzin Engineer

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Unlock the flow of money and access to services for every Indian, starting with free, reliable UPI.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Become India's financial services platform: payments as distribution, lending, insurance and wealth as the profit pool.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Use UPI ubiquity and SmartSpeaker merchant network as low-cost acquisition, then monetise via credit, insurance, broking.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Habit and scale: 70 cr users, 5 cr merchants, Bharat reach, reliability at ~11 billion monthly transactions.

strategy.label: Key bets
strategy.text: Lending revenue doubled to ₹945 cr FY26; Share.Market broking; Indus Appstore versus Google Play.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: If NPCI enforces the 30% cap, should PhonePe cede volume gracefully or fight it, and why?

customers.pain: Need free, instant, reliable payments everywhere
customers.why: Fast UPI, highest merchant acceptance, recharges and bills in one app

customers.pain: Cash handling, payment confirmation fraud, no credit history
customers.why: Free QR, SmartSpeaker audio confirmation, merchant loans from transaction data

customers.pain: Banks reject thin-file applicants; slow paperwork
customers.why: Pre-approved personal, gold, merchant loans via partner lenders in-app

customers.pain: Complex products, agent mis-selling, high minimums
customers.why: Simple term, health, motor policies; low-ticket SIPs and stock broking via Share.Market

customers.pain: Need checkout, distribution and payments reach
customers.why: PhonePe PG, Indus Appstore lower commissions, ads on high-traffic app

products.name: UPI P2P and P2M
products.desc: Free bank-to-bank and merchant payments, market leader

products.name: Recharge and Bills
products.desc: Mobile, DTH, utilities, FASTag, credit card bills

products.name: SmartSpeaker and POS
products.desc: Audio payment alerts and card terminals for merchants

products.name: Payment Gateway
products.desc: Online checkout for merchants and apps

products.name: Credit on UPI
products.desc: RuPay credit cards and credit lines linked to UPI

portfolio.key_metrics: UPI volume share, success rate, merchant actives, speaker rentals
portfolio.guardrails: Fraud losses, downtime, NPCI 30% share cap compliance

products.name: Lending
products.desc: Personal, merchant, gold, home loans via NBFC/bank partners

products.name: Insurance broking
products.desc: Term, health, motor, travel policies distributed in-app

products.name: Share.Market
products.desc: Stock broking and mutual fund platform

portfolio.north_star: Monthly financial-services revenue per transacting user
portfolio.key_metrics: Disbursals, policies sold, SIP book, cross-sell from payments
portfolio.guardrails: Loan delinquencies, mis-selling complaints, regulator observations

products.name: Indus Appstore
products.desc: Android app store with low developer commission

products.name: Pincode
products.desc: Now B2B ERP/sourcing; B2C hyperlocal wound down Dec 2025

products.name: Ads
products.desc: Brand and performance ads on payment surfaces

portfolio.north_star: Monthly active installs via Indus Appstore
portfolio.key_metrics: Developers onboarded, OEM preloads, ad revenue per DAU
portfolio.guardrails: Cash burn, payment-app UX clutter, malware incidents

rows.who_pays: Billers, telcos, some users via platform fees
rows.how: Commissions on recharges/bills; small platform fees on some payments
SmartSpeaker rentals, PG MDR on cards; UPI MDR is zero today
Origination and sourcing fees; FY26 revenue ₹945 cr
Broking commissions, distribution fees, trading brokerage
Ads and app-store fees; currently loss-making

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Payments still the majority; financial services fastest growing; real-money gaming revenue collapsed after 2025 RMG ban.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: 70 cr users pay almost nothing; lenders, insurers, billers and merchants pay for distribution.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: UPI loses money per transaction without MDR; FY26 loss widened to ₹2,792 cr on ads and new bets.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: UPI MDR for large merchants, credit cross-sell, insurance, broking scale, Indus Appstore monetisation.

friction: Home screen cluttered with offers, loans and ads
Failed or pending UPI payments with slow refunds
Fraud and fake-screenshot scams hurt merchant trust
Loan and insurance push feels intrusive to users
Customer support hard to reach for disputes

competitors.label: UPI apps
competitors.text: Google Pay, Paytm, Navi, super.money, BHIM, WhatsApp Pay

competitors.label: Merchant QR
competitors.text: Paytm Soundbox, BharatPe, Google Pay for Business

competitors.label: Lending and wealth
competitors.text: Paytm, Groww, Zerodha, Bajaj Finserv, Policybazaar

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Largest UPI user and merchant base; trusted brand in Bharat

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: 30% cap from Jan 2027, zero MDR, widening losses, IPO timing

news.label: Aug 2026
news.text: FY26 revenue ₹7,920 cr (+11%); loss widened to ₹2,792 cr.

news.label: Apr 2026
news.text: Crossed 70 cr registered users and 5 cr merchants.

news.label: Mar 2026
news.text: Deferred ~$1.3B OFS-only IPO citing volatility; SEBI nod valid 18 months.

news.label: Watch
news.text: NPCI 30% cap at 31 Dec 2026, UPI MDR rules, IPO by Mar 2027.

sources: PhonePe DRHP and RoC filings FY25–FY26, NPCI UPI data, press coverage (Inc42, Outlook Business) 2025–26. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
